deals.date_text: Spin-off approved 30 September 2026, expected to complete 26 October 2026
deals.evidence: The transaction is expected to be completed on Oct. 26, and the sports teams will trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the MSGK (Knicks) and MSGR (Rangers) symbols.
deals.headline: MSG Sports spins the Rangers off into a separately listed company (MSGR)
deals.summary: MSG Sports' board approved the tax-free spin-off of the Rangers business (with the AHL Hartford Wolf Pack and the MSG Training Center) from the Knicks; MSG Sports becomes MSG Knickerbockers (MSGK) and the Rangers trade as MSGR, with James Dolan as CEO and chairman of both.

notes: Revenue, operating and pre-tax results are the Rangers business's own audited combined figures (fiscal year to 30 June 2026, USD thousands in the filing) from the MSGS Spinco Form 10 (10-12B/A filed 30 Sep 2026); the filing also states revenue sharing expense of about $43.5m for FY2026. Forbes' Dec 2025 estimates for comparison: value $4B, revenue $322M, operating income $182M (EBITDA basis), player expenses $100M, gate receipts $121M. Sportico 2026 value $4.15bn supersedes its earlier $3.65bn. Ownership is described as at the spin-off; after 26 Oct 2026 the owner is MSG Rangers (MSGR) shareholders, with the Dolan Family Group controlling about 63.4% of votes. Debt at 30 June 2026 was $16.5m (NHL advance), cash not stated net, so net_debt left null. No attendance, sponsor or social counts found on citable pages.
